MOD = 10**9 + 7

dpA = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
dpB = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]

for i in range(N, -1, -1):
    for j in range(N, -1, -1):
        val1 = 0
        val2 = 0
        if i + 1 <= N:
            maxVal = max(dpA[i + 1][j], dpB[i + 1][j])
            val2 += maxVal
        val2 %= MOD
        if j + 1 <= min(i, N):
            maxVal = max(dpA[i][j + 1], dpB[i][j + 1])
            val2 += maxVal
        val2 %= MOD

        if i + 1 <= N:
            maxVal = max(dpA[i + 1][j], dpB[i + 1][j])
            val1 = max(val1, 1 + val2 - maxVal + dpB[i + 1][j])
            val1 %= MOD
        if j + 1 <= min(i, N):
            maxVal = max(dpA[i][j + 1], dpB[i][j + 1])
            val1 = max(val1, 1 + val2 - maxVal + dpB[i][j + 1])
            val1 %= MOD
        dpA[i][j] = val1
        dpB[i][j] = val2

result = max(dpA[0][0], dpB[0][0])
print(result)
